name: PDB_search_similar_structures
description: Search RCSB PDB by protein sequence, strict structure-shape matching, or text. Results use exact offset pagination: continue with next_start while has_more is true. Sequence identity cutoff is applied only to sequence search; structure search explicitly reports similarity_threshold_applied=false because the official strict_shape_match request has no numeric threshold. Text-result GraphQL enrichment reports its own completeness and missing IDs.

query.description: PDB ID (e.g., '1ABC'), protein sequence (amino acids), or search text (e.g., drug name, protein name, keyword). For structure search, provide PDB ID. For sequence search, provide amino acid sequence. For text search, provide drug name, protein name, or keyword.

search_type.description: Type of search: 'sequence' for sequence-based similarity search, 'structure' for structure-based similarity search using PDB ID, 'text' for text-based search by name or keyword

similarity_threshold.description: Sequence identity cutoff from 0 to 1. Applied only for sequence search. RCSB strict structure-shape search has no numeric threshold, so structure responses explicitly report similarity_threshold_applied=false.

max_results.description: Number of results per page (1-100). Invalid values are rejected rather than silently clamped.

start.description: Zero-based result offset using RCSB's official paginate.start parameter. Continue with data.next_start while data.has_more is true.

similarity_threshold.description: Similarity threshold used (only for sequence/structure searches, null for text search)

total_found.description: Total number of matching structures across all pages

start.description: Zero-based offset of this result page

returned.description: Number of results returned on this page

has_more.description: Whether another result page is available

next_start.description: Offset for the next page, or null when complete

requested_page_complete.description: Whether the requested page was returned and parsed without an upstream count contradiction

result_set_complete.description: Whether this page reaches the end of the complete RCSB result set

similarity_threshold_applied.description: True only for sequence searches, where the value is sent as identity_cutoff

structure_operator.description: Official RCSB structure operator used for structure searches

metadata_enrichment.description: Completeness of optional title, resolution, and method enrichment for text results
